---

SHIPPED: Full security + billing + quality overhaul via 8-agent audit + 10-agent parallel fix

CRITICAL FIXED:
- Hardcoded Gemini API key removed from scripts/crop-preview.ts
- SSRF closed: marketplace/baseUrl validated against VALID_VINTED_DOMAINS allowlist
- winningParams injection stopped: only safe fields destructured (query, catalogId, sizeIds, colorId, brandId, statusIds, order)
- Usage limits now atomic: Prisma updateMany WHERE monthlySearches < limit
- middleware.ts created for centralized API auth on all /api/* routes

BILLING FIXED:
- Cancelled plan gets FREE_LIMIT (not PAID_LIMIT)
- Plan checks: isPaid = plan === 'active' || plan === 'trial' (not 'pro')
- AUTH_URL fallback to NEXTAUTH_URL in docker-compose
- STRIPE_PRICE_ID / STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET guarded with clear error messages

DATA INTEGRITY:
- JSON.parse(s.items) wrapped in try/catch in both routes
- Base64 stores full or null (was slicing at 50000 = corrupt images)
- Gemini model corrected to gemini-2.5-flash
- Token cache key is now userId:baseUrl (not just userId)
- Brand cache gets 1-hour TTL, failures not cached

SEARCH QUALITY:
- Skirt moved to DRESS_TYPES (letter sizing, not waist numbers)
- Null guard on item.color before .toUpperCase()
- Color partial-match sorted longest-first (DARK GREEN before GREEN)
- Missing shoe subtypes added

COMMIT: 7bb19b6 — 44 files, 422 insertions, 84,699 deletions (mostly .har removal)
